name: Nothing covers what is being shown
description: On a screen-share clip the screen is the content, so no picture is placed over it.
when: the clip shows a screen share — code, a terminal, a browser, a game, a design tool

then.prompt: Do not place pictures over the screen: what is on it is the thing being talked about. Keep the captions clear of the seam between the screen and the camera, and leave the speaker's own frame alone.
